items.headline: Wall Street Closes Lower Amid Geopolitical Tensions and Rising Yields
items.summary: U.S. equities closed in negative territory today as investor sentiment was dampened by escalating U.S.-Iran tensions, which pushed oil prices higher and sent Treasury yields to multi-year peaks. The tech sector, particularly AI-related stocks, experienced significant selling pressure, contributing to broad market declines.

items.headline: Home Depot Beats Earnings Estimates, Reaffirms Guidance
items.summary: Shares of Home Depot ($HD) rose almost 2% after the home improvement retailer reported fiscal Q2 earnings and revenue that topped consensus expectations and reaffirmed its full-year guidance.

items.headline: Palantir Leads Gainers Amid Broader Market Downturn
items.summary: Palantir Technologies ($PLTR) saw a significant surge, gaining 29.4% today, standing out as one of the few strong performers in an otherwise down market.

items.headline: Micron Technology Plunges as AI Stocks Face Pressure
items.summary: Micron Technology ($MU) shares dropped significantly by 5.9% as broader artificial intelligence-related stocks experienced a sharp pullback amidst high interest rates and profit-taking.

items.headline: AMD Shares Fall Amid Semiconductor Sector Weakness
items.summary: Advanced Micro Devices ($AMD) saw its stock decline by 3.3% today, contributing to the overall weakness in the semiconductor sector driven by rising bond yields and Middle East tensions.

items.headline: Energy Sector Outperforms While Tech, Communication Services Lag
items.summary: The Energy sector advanced 0.9% today, primarily benefiting from surging oil prices due to escalating geopolitical risks. Conversely, Communication Services declined 1.5%, Consumer Staples fell 1.5%, and Financials were down 1%, with Technology also broadly underperforming.

items.headline: Housing Starts Miss Estimates, Manufacturing PMI Rises
items.summary: July's Housing Starts came in below expectations at 1.239 million seasonally adjusted annual units, while the Empire State Manufacturing Index for August rose significantly to 20.6, surpassing forecasts and indicating robust industrial activity.

items.headline: U.S.-Iran Tensions Drive Oil Prices Higher, Push Yields to Multi-Year Peaks
items.summary: The expiration of the U.S.-Iran ceasefire agreement and renewed belligerent rhetoric led to Brent crude topping $90 per barrel and the 10-year Treasury yield hitting a 19-month high of 4.74%, significantly impacting market sentiment and stock valuations.
